--------                                                                    
                                                                              
  **@pierre** wrote on 2026-10-24 15:26:                                      
                                                                              
  Follow-up after measured p diagnosis: direct MCRA-p conditioning is not     
  selected. Noise-only quality p reaches .9988 at 619 ms and .999992 at 917   
  ms, with all analyzed bins above .5, so it is not an absence posterior.     
                                                                              
  Predeclared alternative: retain independent natural DD clean-power          
  prediction, but condition the EXTRA noise penalty on the modeled noise      
  fraction a=Pn/(Ps+Pn)=1/(1+xi), not on MCRA p. For the surrogate quadratic  
  risk J(g)=Ps(1-g)^2+Pn*g^2+(C-1)**Pn**a*g^2, the optimum is G=xi/[xi+1+(C-  
  1)/(1+xi)]. No exact-MMSE or calibrated speech-probability claim. No        
  thresholds, knobs, preset/schema changes or MCRA/profile changes. At xi=0   
  its effective strength is C; high xi tends toward ordinary Wiener; C=1 is   
  ordinary Wiener for every xi. Public zero-depth final endpoint remains      
  independent and exact.                                                      
                                                                              
  Before production edits: preserve the complete noise-only p diagnostic and  
  add independently aligned rendered noise attenuation windows for the same 40
  dB noise step and gentle independent noise channel. Freeze the baseline and 
  extend the noise guard to <=1 dB attenuation loss in every declared window, 
  in addition to the unchanged settled independent-noise guard. Derive        
  separate f64 quadratic-risk optima/limits/monotonic fixtures before         
  implementation.                                                             
                                                                              
  Mandatory unchanged gates: vowel projection >=.5 in both FFT modes, all 36  
  development full-source SDR deltas >=-.25 dB, settled noise attenuation loss
  <=1 dB, noise/profile invariance and all original                           
  tone/DFT/zero/heap/EOF/reset/latency checks. New independent recurrence and 
  control-state invariance must pass. Reject and restore the committed        
  production source if any gate fails; no fixture-driven retuning. This is a  
  new combined hypothesis; prior DD rejection and p diagnosis remain final    
  evidence. All plugin scopes remain partial and held-out/native requirements 
  stay open.
